mentions.name: Infinite Battery
mentions.description: A repairable, fireproof, and more sustainable e-bike battery. The project emphasizes longevity through repairability, improved sustainability, and fire safety, with a video demonstrating its fireproof qualities.
mentions.problem: E-bike batteries are typically not repairable, are less sustainable, and pose fire risks.
mentions.source_excerpt: We're building a repairable and more sustainable e-bike battery (that's fireproof!) at https://infinite-battery.com

mentions.name: Infinite Battery
mentions.description: A repairable and sustainable e-bike battery that users fully own and control. It is connected, cross-compatible across e-bikes, and designed for easy repair as an alternative to proprietary 'black box' batteries.
mentions.problem: E-bike batteries today are 'black box' products: proprietary, non-repairable, and not owned or controlled by the user.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're working on a repairable and sustainable e-bike battery that you fully own and control!

We want to get rid of "black box batteries" and move to connected, cross-compatible, and easy to repair batteries!
